latest.title: 'We have lost control': Crypto pioneer warns AI could trigger systemic banking and infrastructure shocks
latest.description: Marc van der Chijs sold much of his bitcoin to invest in AI. Now, growing concerns about the technology accompany a move to put some profits back into crypto.

latest.title: Flames reported near Saudi capital airport as Pakistan presses Iran over energy supplies
latest.description: Smoke and flames were seen near Riyadh’s main airport after Saudi civil-defense alerts, while Pakistan urged Iran to protect energy supplies and shipping.

latest.title: Ripple says asset managers are preparing for XRP Ledger’s next payments upgrade
latest.description: The upcoming Batch V1.1 can make linked asset and payment transfers succeed together or fail together, and Ripple says commercial projects are already being built around the feature after an extensive security review.

latest.title: Student loan borrowers exiting SAVE may face sharply higher payments if they don't take action soon
latest.description: Millions of student loan borrowers could see their monthly bills skyrocket if they don't move into an affordable repayment plan soon. Here's what to know.

latest.title: Solana's Heartbeat Quickens: Block Times Fall 17% in Latest Speed Upgrade
latest.description: The network's clock just sped up again, but the extra speed goes to freshness, not capacity.

latest.title: Consumer sentiment is in the dumps despite a solid economy. Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'
latest.description: Goldman economist Joseph Briggs said broader pessimism in society may be contributing to struggling consumer sentiment even as the economy chugs along.

latest.title: Buffett takes next step in plan to keep Berkshire from straying
latest.description: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman, passing the job to his son, Howard.

latest.title: 'The orange tie stays': Michael Saylor responds to venture capitalist's bitcoin obituary
latest.description: "Bitcoin feels like the CD in the age of Spotify, the DVD in the age of Netflix," wrote Jason Calacanis.

latest.title: The AI kill switch, explained: 'It's not too little, but it's probably too late'
latest.description: As runaway AI fears reach a crescendo, policymakers and tech leaders are weighing the effectiveness of a magic AI stop button known as a kill switch.

latest.title: Robinhood Chain fees collapse 97% even as transactions stay near record highs
latest.description: Seven-day average fees fell 82% while transaction counts slipped 6%, with about $1.5 billion a day still changing hands.

latest.title: Why Wall Street giants build tokenization money for institutions, not regular consumers
latest.description: JPMorgan and Citi move billions in tokenized deposits, but only among their branches. A U.K. challenger bank is about to do something neither has done.

latest.title: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
latest.description: Bastion Platforms National Trust Company will offer stablecoin custody and wallets, payment infrastructure and white-label issuance from a single federally regulated entity.

latest.title: Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
latest.description: Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.

latest.title: Hong Kong jails former banker over $1.6B false credit, cryptocurrency bribes: Report
latest.description: Former banking official gets four years in prison over false letters of credit and accepting $470,000 in cryptocurrency bribes.

latest.title: A new arms race is unfolding on the ocean floor
latest.description: Countries and companies are investing in technologies for underwater use amid concerns about the vulnerability of critical infrastructure on the ocean floor.

latest.title: Cramer’s week ahead: What to watch as Wall Street navigates a tough September
latest.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said investors could be in for a relatively quiet week as Wall Street works its way through a historically difficult September.

latest.title: Anthropic selects Accenture as first embedded evaluator to help implement Amodei's slowdown proposal
latest.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have been under intense scrutiny after researchers warned about the potential for AI to cause catastrophic harm to humanity.

latest.title: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public
latest.description: Nscale is the latest artificial intelligence neocloud to turn to public markets.
